Time as an Index [T/E/M · unmetered]

Across 31 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems over discrete oracle models and N=65,536 SHA-256 spectral tests (0 / 32,768 FFT bins below Bonferroni p=10^-6), O(1) 'future lookup' reduces to salted-away Hellman precomputation.

1/2 Formal & spectral bounds:
- Horizon.lean & Paradox.lean: 31 theorems (0 sorry across 6/6 Lean checkers in bwrap) on causal cones & per-query salts
- Hellman (1980) T*M^2 = N^2 resets to cold work under fresh nonces
- 195-entry literature catalog of timing anomalies [S]

2/2 Scope & limits:
- CTC collapse results (D-CTC=PSPACE, Aaronson & Watrous 2009) model hypothetical fixed-point loops, not lab hardware
- N=65,536 SHA-256 FFT scan rules out gross 2^16 periodicity, NOT cryptanalytic security
- Strictly unmetered (joules = null)
